name: Recurring small cash payments to border, customs or permit agents
description: Repeated low-value cash disbursements or petty cash entries labelled 'expediting', 'facilitation' or 'processing' at ports, borders or ministries.
fp: Some official fees are legitimately paid in cash with receipts.
